records.text: The final snapshot assertion records Amber in Red's custody at the southern depot.
At the snapshot, Bronze was in Red's custody at the northern depot. The entry is effective.
Copper's snapshot custodian was Red; its custody location was the northern depot.
The effective snapshot entry states that Amber was in Blue's custody at the southern depot.
A duplicate dispatch note also asserts that Bronze was in Red's custody at the northern depot at the snapshot.
Withdrawn draft: Copper in Blue's custody at the southern depot. The draft was fully withdrawn before the snapshot; this record makes no effective custody claim.
Next month's forecast proposes moving Amber into Red's custody at the northern depot. This is solely a future plan, and states no custody at the snapshot.
